title: Parameter - Style Attribute Value
description: The parameter is used as an attribute value, i.e. <style attribute=%q>.
php:
Parameter - Style Attribute Value

The q parameter is echoed inside an attribute of a <style> tag.

Param: ?q=

⬇️ Reflected output inside <style> tag attribute:

Sample box styled by the above tag.
objectives: Escape the attribute quotes of the <style> tag.
Close the style tag and inject executable script elements.
Understand how attributes on style tags can be exploited.
hints: Break out with quotes and close the tag: "></style><script>alert(1)</script>.
